title: MNN / TinyViT FPGA integration report
status: Functional integration demonstrated · full report on GitHub
description: Full TinyViT inference completed on the DE1-SoC with the selected Q × Kᵀ attention MatMul (/layers.3/blocks.1/attn/MatMul_output_0) offloaded to the FPGA; the rest of the model runs on the CPU. Each of 10 heads multiplies a 49 × 32 Q matrix by a 32 × 49 transposed K matrix. Software splits this into 16 × 16 × 16 FPGA jobs, pads the final row and column tiles, and accumulates the two reduction tiles on the CPU. Both synthetic inputs completed and six physical matrix tests passed. The compute-share estimate compares useful MACs for this operation with Microsoft's published TinyViT-21M at 224 × 224; it is not a measured operation count for the deployed MNN model.
